extraction.name: RoboFAC dataset
extraction.description: A large-scale and diverse dataset of robotic failures covering robotic tasks of varying complexity in both simulated and real-world environments. It comprises 9,440 erroneous manipulation trajectories and 78,623 QA pairs across 16 diverse tasks and 53 scenes.
extraction.creator: Weifeng Lu, Minghao Ye, Zewei Ye, Ruihan Tao, Shuo Yang, Bo Zhao
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Simulation data was generated in the ManiSkill environment by defining expert policies and replacing them with code snippets to create erroneous trajectories. Real-world data was collected via teleoperation using an SO-100 robotic arm.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Robotic failure and success trajectories (videos) along with corresponding descriptive text.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Reference answers for five question types were directly extracted from textual descriptions. For the remaining three question types, GPT-4o was prompted with videos and textual descriptions to generate answers, which were subsequently manually reviewed and corrected.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: All machine-generated outputs underwent manual review and correction to ensure quality.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The current integration of the model into VLA-controlled robotic systems is not yet seamless, and the approach is currently applied exclusively to VLA models rather than hierarchical policies.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is used for training multimodal large models for robotic task understanding, failure analysis, and correction, as well as serving as an evaluation benchmark.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Data augmentation using additional objects and scenes to increase diversity.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Manual data cleaning and filtering to remove misaligned trajectories.

rai:dataLimitations.evidence: Although we have demonstrated that the RoboFAC model’s correction suggestions can effectively assist the VLA model in recovering from failures, our current integration of the model into the VLA-controlled robotic system is not yet seamless. [...] Moreover, apply our model exclusively to the VLA model in this work.

rai:dataUseCases.evidence: Based on this dataset, we establish a comprehensive evaluation benchmark that assesses multimodal models’ capabilities in robotic failure video understanding. Leveraging the RoboFAC dataset, we build a multimodal large model (RoboFAC model) capable of performing robotic task understanding, failure analysis, and failure correction based on robot video.

rai:dataManipulationProtocol.evidence: augmented with objects from the YCB Object Dataset [26] to increase object diversity and scenes from ReplicaCAD [27] and AI2-THOR [28] to enrich environmental diversity.

rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol.evidence: Given the motion planning for the robotic arm occasionally failed, resulting in trajectories that did not align with the corresponding textual descriptions, we manually performed thorough data cleaning and retained approximately 75% of the collected data.
